therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Microtubule stabilization (nab-paclitaxel) and nucleoside analog incorporation disrupting DNA synthesis (gemcitabine)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced tumor cell cytotoxicity through dual mechanism targeting cell division and DNA replication

safety_signals: Higher grade 3+ adverse events (371 vs 286 participants)
More serious adverse events (176 vs 96 participants)
Higher rates of febrile neutropenia (16 vs 3 cases)
Increased hematologic toxicities including anemia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia
results.dose_information: nab-Paclitaxel 125 mg/m² on Days 1, 8, and 15 plus Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m² on Days 1, 8, and 15 of every 28 day cycle for 6 cycles

context.duration: 6 cycles of 28 days each (approximately 6 months treatment)
